"''FN Twenty-one eighty-seven?|Finn and 926|}} '''926''' was a [[human]] [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] who served the [[First Order]] during its [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] with the [[Resistance]]. During his [[time]] aboard the [[Mega-class Star Dreadnought|''Mega''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Supremacy]]'', 926 encountered [[Finn]]—an ex-stormtrooper who once served with 926 in [[Batch Eight]]. Unaware of Finn's [[Treason|desertion]] from the [[First Order military|military]], the [[trooper]] assumed that his former comrade had become an [[First Order officer|officer]] due to the latter's [[First Order military uniforms|disguise]]. Believing that a fellow member of Batch Eight had risen to the [[officer]]s' [[Military rank|ranks]], 926 congratulated Finn on his promotion. ==Biography== {{Quote|You don't remember me. Nine twenty-six, from induct camp. Batch Eight. But I remember ''you''.|926, to Finn|}} [[File:HuxAndStormtroopersAtCommandCenter-TFAOfficialTeaser.jpg|thumb|left|250px|926 was part of a new generation of stormtroopers trained by the First Order.]] 926 was a [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] who once served with [[Finn|FN-2187]] in [[Batch Eight]] prior to the latter's [[Treason|defection]] from the [[First Order]]. During their [[time]] in induct camp, 926 gave [[FN Trooper Corps|FN]]-2187 a run for top spot in target practice.''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: A Junior Novel]]'' They would ultimately meet again during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the First Order and the [[Resistance]], albeit under different circumstances. By then 926 was stationed aboard the ''[[Supremacy]]'', a [[Mega-class Star Dreadnought|''Mega''-class Star Dreadnought]] which served as the [[flagship]] of [[Supreme Leader]] [[Snoke]]. It was on the [[Star Dreadnought|Dreadnought]] where 926 encountered "Finn," a Resistance operative whom he recognized as FN-2187. However, he was unaware of the former stormtrooper's defection from the [[First Order military|military]] as well as his mission to infiltrate the ''Supremacy'' and disable its [[hyperspace tracker]]. He also mistook Finn's stolen [[First Order military uniforms|uniform]] as a sign that his former comrade had been promoted to the [[First Order officer|officers']] [[Military rank|ranks]]. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|I know I'm not supposed to initiate contact with officers, but look at you! Never took you for captain material. Batch Eight, heigh-ho!|926, to Finn|}} [[Trooper]] 926 was a [[human]]. His skills as a marksman were comparable to FN-2187—another stormtrooper whose own skills were considered exceptional by his instructors.''[[The Force Awakens: Finn's Story]]'' Upon encountering FN-2187, later known as Finn, once more after their time in induct camp, 926 remembered him as a fellow member of Batch Eight. Unlike their trainers, who thought that Finn had the potential of becoming an [[officer]] one [[Standard day|day]], 926 never took him for [[captain]] material. However, he was pleased to see that someone from Batch Eight had evidently risen in the First Order hierarchy. Although troopers were not permitted to converse with officers, 926 broke this rule to congratulate Finn and to express pride in Batch Eight. Before parting ways, he gave Finn a friendly swat on the posterior. ==Behind the scenes== 926 first appeared in [[Jason Fry]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition]] ''simultaneously with the ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: A Junior Novel]]'' by [[Michael Kogge]], both of which were novelizations for the [[sequel trilogy]]'s [[2017]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']]. [[Tom Hardy]] portrayed 926 in the scene in which he encountered Finn on the ''Supremacy'', although that scene was ultimately cut from ''The Last Jedi''.{{WebCite|url=http://www.indiewire.com/2017/12/tom-hardy-star-wars-last-jedi-cameo-deleted-scene-1201910252|text=Tom Hardy Was Cut From 'Star Wars: The Last Jedi,' But Here's What His Cameo Looked Like|author=Sharf, Zack|date=2017-12-21|work=IndieWire|archivedate=20180618211141}} The cut material is available in a deleted scene on the [[2018]] Blu-ray release of the film.{{WebCite|url=https://io9.gizmodo.com/all-the-new-things-we-learned-from-the-star-wars-the-l-1823756546|text=All the New Things We Learned From the ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' Blu-Ray|author=Lussier, Germain|date=2018-03-14|quote=The home release has the extended version of the "Mega Destroyer Incursion" by Finn, Rose, and DJ. It includes a lot more tension, more humor, a visual homage to the classic '50s romantic dramedy ''The Apartment'', and even a cameo by Ralph Ineson (''The Witch'') as a First Order officer who's onto their games. Although no one and nothing in the extras confirms it, we're pretty sure a Stormtrooper that talks to Finn in the extended scene is played by Tom Hardy, as has been rumored.|archivedate=20200316142412}} ==Appearances== *{{Film|VIII}} {{Del}} *''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition (audiobook)}} {{1st|''Star Wars: The Last Jedi: A Junior Novel''}} *''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: A Junior Novel]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Last Jedi: A Junior Novel (audiobook)}} {{1st|''Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition''}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=926 |ja=926 }} [[Category:First Order stormtroopers]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]]
